test_cohort: ODIR-5K labelled training release (7,000 images / 3,500 patients), labels unopened
ddr_same_image_screen: pHash<=7 candidates (45,759 pairs) verified by green-channel high-pass (vessel) thumbnail correlation; borderline 0.45-0.47 visually different retinas; copies cluster >= 0.6
decision: Exclude whole ODIR patients with any image matching DDR (vessel corr >= 0.5) or any geometric match; ODIR shares images with DDR, which trains K2/K3 and round 3.
limitation: Copies beyond pHash distance 7 (heavy crop/rotation) can be missed.
